import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site')
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
def cert(m):
    t=m.tree_
    out=[]
    for i in range(t.node_count):
        if t.children_left[i]==-1:
            v=t.value[i][0]
            out.append([int(m.classes_[int(np.argmax(v))])])
        else:
            out.append([int(t.feature[i]), int(round(2*t.threshold[i])), int(t.children_left[i]), int(t.children_right[i])])
    return out
# single class
X=np.array([[1,2],[3,4]]); y=np.array([0,0])
m=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10,random_state=42,class_weight='balanced').fit(X,y)
print('single class:', cert(m), m.classes_, m.tree_.node_count, m.tree_.value)
# identical X, different y
X=np.array([[5,5],[5,5],[5,5]]); y=np.array([0,1,1])
m=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10,random_state=42,class_weight='balanced').fit(X,y)
print('identical:', cert(m), m.tree_.value)
# single row
X=np.array([[7,7]]); y=np.array([3])
m=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10,random_state=42,class_weight='balanced').fit(X,y)
print('one row:', cert(m), m.classes_)
# bigger
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
X=rng.integers(0,3029,(50,4)); y=rng.integers(0,3,50)
m=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10,random_state=42,class_weight='balanced').fit(X,y)
print('big:', len(cert(m)))
print(cert(m)[:6])
print('predict', m.predict(np.array([[100,200,300,400]])))
